\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{آینده} (âyande)}{آینده (âyande)}]{\fa{آینده} (âyande) — next, coming; the future}

\label{lesson:FA-C138-ayande}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for once, then the Persian for to spend.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{آینده}}
\textbf{\fa{آینده}} — \emph{âyande} — \textquotedblleft{}next, coming; the future\textquotedblright{}. The future uses \textbf{\fa{خواهم}} with the verb's past stem (\textbf{\fa{رفت}} from \textbf{\fa{رفتن}}): \textbf{\fa{هفته} \fa{آینده} \fa{به} \fa{مشهد} \fa{خواهم} \fa{رفت}} — \emph{hafte-ye âyande be mashhad khâham raft} — \textquotedblleft{}Next week I will go to Mashhad.\textquotedblright{}

One more word for this chapter.
\end{grammarlens}
